_about: Per-booth SEIFA lane for the statistics-era federal frame 1996: the venue's CD (ASGC 1996) scores + national deciles (ABS's quantile recipe derived here) via the venue point from data/booth-locations-history.json, joined by the demo lane's own point-in-poly + 1,500 m era-linework nearest rescue (the same CD assignment ride, so no booth mixes lanes across two districts). The area is THE PREMISES area — a geographic proxy for the catchment's SES, not an aggregate of catchment voters. Pre-2001 censuses carry no IRSAD (the five-index era). Coordinate-less records carry note=noCoords and null seifa lanes, exactly the GCP-era contract.

_pcti.method: seifaPct = the prePrefs area's score percentile among all scored areas of the measured cube (ascending score, min-rank on ties, r6 half-up). seifaInterp joins the same venue point into the OTHER bracketing census-era geometry; pcti = (1-f)*pct0 + f*pct1 computed from the emitted r6-rounded pct0/pct1/f (the file re-derives its own pcti).
